description: November 13 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 3, birthday number 4, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 13 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the third decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Moon as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 4. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: November 13 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: The Moon, ruler of Cancer, takes over as sub-ruler when Scorpio's third decan begins around November 13. Emotional memory and protectiveness come forward. Thirteen reduces to 4, adding steadiness and commitment to building things that last. The combined reading points to a guardian figure: someone who creates a safe, dependable home base and defends it fiercely.

On November 13 the Sun usually sits at about 20° Scorpio, in the third decan, where Moon is the sub-ruler alongside Pluto. The final decan of Scorpio takes the Moon as sub-ruler, the luminary that governs Cancer. Mid-to-late November birthdays therefore blend Scorpio's depth with a strong protective and domestic instinct. Those born here are commonly described as fiercely loyal to family and close friends, sensitive to atmosphere and slow to forget either kindness or betrayal. The lunar influence can make moods shift quickly beneath a composed surface. When they feel safe, these natives tend to offer remarkably steady emotional support, the kind that stays through the difficult chapter and not just the easy one.

sections.heading: November 13 in numerology
paragraphs: Born on the 13th, your birthday compound is 13, reducing as 1 + 3 = 4. Some numerologists treat 13 as a karmic debt number, read not as bad luck but as a call to patient, consistent effort. The 1 adds initiative and the 3 adds imagination, and both feed into the 4's practical discipline. Those born on this day are frequently described as hard workers with an inventive streak, able to rebuild something better after it has fallen apart. The day number is secondary, yet in the 13 it often surfaces as a stubborn, constructive determination.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one November 13 birthday to the next: it is 22 for 1960, 5 for 1970, 6 for 1980 and 7 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22.

sections.heading: Born on November 13: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 13 is the 317th day of the year (318th in a leap year). By November 23, 10 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Sagittarius.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 13, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on November 13 include Huang Xianfan (1899), Robert Louis Stevenson (1850) and Whoopi Goldberg (1955).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 13?
faq.answer: November 13 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the third decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Moon.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 13?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 13 the Life Path is 22 in 1960, 5 in 1970, 6 in 1980, 7 in 1990, 8 in 2000, 9 in 2010 and 1 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 4 for everyone born on the 13th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 13?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a November 13 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 13?
faq.answer: November 13 is also the birthday of Huang Xianfan (1899), Robert Louis Stevenson (1850) and Whoopi Goldberg (1955). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
